vv73:1.1: Alaṅkato malyadharo suvattho sukuṇḍalī kappitakesamassu āmuttahatthābharaṇo yasassī dibbe vimānamhi yathāsi candimā. || ||
vv73:2.1: Dibbā ca vīṇā pavadanti vaggū aṭṭhaṭṭhakā sikkhitā sādhurūpā dibbā ca kaññā Tidasacarā uḷārā naccanti gāyanti pamodayanti. || ||
vv73:3.1: Deviddhipatto 'si mahānubhāvo manussabhūto kim akāsi puññaṃ kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvo vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī ti. || ||
vv73:4.1: So devaputto attamano Moggallānena pucchito pañhaṃ puṭṭho viyākāsi yassa kammass' idaṃ phalaṃ. || ||
vv73:5.1: Ahaṃ manussesu manussabhūto disvāna samaṇe sādhurūpe sampannavijjācaraṇe yasassī bahussute sīlavante pasanne annañ ca pānañ ca pasannacitto sakkacca dānaṃ vipulaṃ adāsiṃ.
